text: {"contradictions":[{"a":"'ajjhattasanti' ti yam etaṃ atthaṃ kathan nu dhīrehi paveditaṃ taṃ.","b":"'santim' etam anupassanto, kathaṃ paṇḍitā pakarentī","kind":"sense","why":"A asks how the wise define 'inner peace', while B asks how they explain/describe the act of observing it.","certainty":"medium"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[{"b":"maññāmi etam mohan ti, ye keci diṭṭhiyā suddhiṃ vadantī"}]}

contradictions.a: 'ajjhattasanti' ti yam etaṃ atthaṃ kathan nu dhīrehi paveditaṃ taṃ.
contradictions.why: A asks how the wise define 'inner peace', while B asks how they explain/describe the act of observing it.

additions.b: maññāmi etam mohan ti, ye keci diṭṭhiyā suddhiṃ vadantī
